reference.behavior: Empty list constructors return non-nil slices while rest, initial, slice, and concat preserve their upstream nil-slice results.

request.name: list-nil-slices
request.template: {{list | toJson}}/{{tuple | toJson}}|{{rest (list) | toJson}}/{{initial (list) | toJson}}/{{slice (list) | toJson}}|{{mustRest (list) | toJson}}/{{mustInitial (list) | toJson}}/{{mustSlice (list) | toJson}}|{{concat | toJson}}/{{concat (list) | toJson}}|{{reverse (list) | toJson}}/{{compact (list) | toJson}}/{{uniq (list) | toJson}}/{{without (list) | toJson}}/{{chunk 3 (list) | toJson}}
